fnol_text: My name is Kwame Lindqvist and I live at 557 Juniper Drive, Madison, WI 53750. You can reach me on (555) 348-9337 or kwame.lindqvist@example.com. I was stopped at lights on 14 May 2024 when the car behind, driven by Fatima Thorne, went into the back of mine. Rear bumper and boot are badly damaged. Policy MT-2024-00060. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Lindqvist on (555) 348-9337 to acknowledge the claim. Kwame confirmed the loss date as 14 May 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Callum Ferreira gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Fatima Thorne reports whiplash and attended Mercy General. Kwame reports a mild concussion.
